note: workflow default_values are merged by the backend

effective_date.description: The date on which the NDA or confidentiality agreement becomes effective, normalized to YYYY-MM-DD. Return an empty string when absent or uncertain; do not substitute a signature or filing date.

jurisdiction.description: The country, state, or legal jurisdiction whose laws govern the agreement. Return an empty string when absent or uncertain; do not guess from an address, venue, or incorporation location.

party.description: All contracting parties to the agreement, each listed once. Return an empty array when no party can be identified; do not include signers, representatives, advisers, or other non-parties.

term.description: The confidentiality-obligation duration normalized as number_unit, for example 1_year or 18_months. Return an empty string when absent or uncertain; do not guess.
